study type: Animal experimental study (prenatal oral toxicity evaluation)
outcome: Maternal toxicity (body weights, food intake, anogenital distance, clinical observations)
Embryo-fetal toxicity (number of corpora lutea, resorptions, implantations, fetus weights, sex ratio, incidence of anomalies)
cohort: Pregnant rats were orally gavaged daily with Fenuflakes or a vehicle control from day 0 to day 19 post-conception.
finding: Oral prenatal exposure to Fenuflakes up to 2000 mg/kg/day in rats did not show significant toxicological changes in maternal or embryo-fetal evaluations, establishing a 'No Observed Adverse Effect Level' (NOAEL) greater than 2000 mg/kg/day.
